set.expected_answer: Attribute + Skill + Modifier. The three components of a MUNDANE dice pool. ('Modifier' covers Specialties, equipment, and situational bonuses/penalties.) Adding a Discipline makes it a SUPERNATURAL pool, so it is not part of a mundane one. Minimum accepted: Attribute + Skill + Modifier(s).

note: Mundane pool excludes Discipline (VtR core). ST-confirmed 2026-06-25.

set.question: 19. How do wounds affect frenzy risk?
set.expected_answer: No fixed Health threshold. Wounds penalise the single Resolve + Composure frenzy-resistance roll: -1 when wounded at all, and -3 when wounded in the last three Health boxes. (These are GENERAL frenzy modifiers - fear frenzy specifically is triggered by fire, sunlight, or torpor.) Accept answers giving the -1 / -3 wound penalties and/or noting there is no fixed threshold.
